S1:16.text: And Cain went forth from the face of our Lord, and dwelt as a fugitiue on the earth at the eaſt ſide of Eden.

S1:17.text: And Cain knewe his wife, who conceiued, and brought forth Enoch And he built a citie, & called the name thereof by the name of his ſonne, Enoch.

S1:18.text: Moreouer Enoch be gat Irad, and Irad begat Mauiael, and Mauiael begat Mathuſael, and Mathuſael begat Lamech.

S1:19.text: who tooke two wiues, the name of the one was Ada, and the name of the other Sella.

S1:20.text: And Ada brought forth Iabel, who was the father of them that dwel in tents, and of heardſmen.

S1:21.text: And his brothers name was Iubal: he was the father of them that ſing on harpe & organes.

S1:22.text: Sella alſo brought forth Tubalcain, who was a hammerer & worker in al worke of braſſe & iron. And the ſiſter of Tubalcain was Nocina.

S1:25.text: Adam alſo knewe his wife again and she brought forth a ſonne, and called his name Seth, ſaying God hath giuen me other ſeede for Abel, whom Cain ſlewe.

S9:4.text: Abel alſo :: offred of the firſt begotten of his hocke, and of their fat: and our Lord had reſpect to Abel, &C to his giftes.

S9:5.text: But to Cain, and to his giftes he had not reſpect: & Cain was exceeding angrie, and his countenance abated.

S9:6.text: And our Lord ſaid to him Why art thou angrie and why is thy countinance fallen
